section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the methodology for measuring body dissatisfaction using the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (Swami et al. 2008c), a 10-point figural rating scale with photographic images of women. Participants rated their current body and ideal body, with body dissatisfaction operationalized as the absolute difference between these ratings. The measure has demonstrated good validity and test-retest reliability.

section_summary.extract_value: Section 2.2.1 describes the measurement of body dissatisfaction using the Photographic Figure Rating Scale, where participants rate their current and ideal body figures on a 10-point scale. Table 1 presents sample characteristics for two sub-samples: a US sample (N=8,925, mean age 30.22) and a Non-US sample (N=742, mean age 27.70), with comparable education levels (approximately 69% with college or higher education) and different mean BMIs (26.75 vs. 24.93).
